What We Do

Services

From a single custom part to short run production, PrairieTech3D delivers precision fabrication on demand — no minimum order, no corporate runaround.

01
On-Demand 3D Printing

You find it, we print it. Send us your file or a reference and we'll quote it, print it, and ship it. FDM multi-material capability with a six printer fleet ready to run.

02
Custom & Personalized Parts

Need something that doesn't exist yet? Custom dimensions, personalized text, specific geometry — we work from your measurements, sketches, or technical drawings.

03
Rapid Prototyping

Validate your design before committing to expensive tooling. Fast turnaround on functional prototypes for product development, engineering validation, and concept proof.

04
B2B & Industrial

Replacement parts, jigs, fixtures, custom tooling aids, and short run components for businesses and manufacturers. Local pickup available in Somonauk, IL.

05
Multi-Material & Multi-Color

Bambu AMS capability means real multi-color and multi-material prints in a single job. Logos, branded parts, color-coded components — done right the first time.

06
Design Assistance

Not sure how to get from idea to printable file? We can work from hand sketches, measurements, or napkin drawings to produce a ready-to-print design.

The Process

How It Works

1
Submit Your Request

Who We Are

Prairie Roots.
Precision Tech.

PrairieTech3D is a one-person custom fabrication operation based in Somonauk, Illinois — right in the heart of the northern Illinois prairie. Six 3D printers, a fully equipped fabrication shop, and the kind of personal service you can only get from someone who actually answers their own phone.

We work with individuals, small businesses, and industrial clients who need custom parts made right, made fast, and made by someone who cares about the outcome. No minimums, no corporate process, no waiting three weeks for a quote.

From a single replacement part to a short production run, from a hand sketch to a finished prototype — if you can imagine it, we can build it.

What We Can Build Together
Technology
Rooted in the Prairie.

Surrounded by the same fields that feed the world and supply the materials that make modern manufacturing possible — PrairieTech3D is precision fabrication that grows from the ground up.

Built With Purpose

Printing Greener.
Building Smarter.

3D printing is one of the most material-efficient manufacturing methods available — parts are built layer by layer using only what's needed, with virtually zero waste compared to traditional subtractive manufacturing.

At PrairieTech3D we are committed to responsible fabrication — from using PLA filaments derived from renewable corn starch, to minimizing support material, to recycling failed prints wherever possible. The same prairie that surrounds us inspires us to leave it better than we found it.

🌽
Corn-Derived PLA

Our primary filament — PLA — is made from fermented corn starch, a renewable agricultural resource grown right here in Illinois. Biodegradable and responsibly sourced.

♻️
Near Zero Waste Manufacturing

Unlike CNC machining or cutting which removes material, FDM 3D printing deposits only what the part requires — dramatically reducing material waste on every job.

📦
On Demand = Less Overproduction

We print what you need, when you need it. No warehouses full of unsold inventory, no excess production runs, no waste from obsolete stock.

🌱
Prairie Rooted Values

Surrounded by working farmland, sustainability isn't a marketing buzzword here — it's a way of life. We operate with respect for the land and community that supports us.
